Gomwick's corpse is in the Forest, protected by his dog  Scratch in Act One.

Involvement

Act One

Using  Speak with Dead can reveal that he was a courier delivering letters to Baldur's Gate. Until  Scratch calms down, the dog does not allow Gomwick's body to be looted.

It is possible to return the letters which Gomwick was carrying to Sword Coast Couriers in Act Three. There is no reward for this, but  Danzo Arkwright expresses his sorrow at hearing of Gomwick's demise.

North of Gomwick's corpse is a small island which allows the party to jump across the river and bypass the Blighted Village to reach the Risen Road.

Speak with Dead

Gomwick's corpse can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Gomwick
      ... Gomwick...
  • What's your profession?
    • Gomwick
      ... runner... Fleetfoot... Courier Company...
  • Where are you from?
    • Gomwick
      ... from... Triel...
  • Why were you in the forest?
    • Gomwick
      ... letters... delivery to... Baldur's Gate...
      • Where did you keep the letters?
        • Gomwick
          ... in... bag... standard... issue...
  • What happened to you?
    • Gomwick
      ... pack of... gnolls... claws... teeth...
      • How did Scratch get away?
        • Gomwick
          ... made... run away... yelled... crying...
  • I've taken Scratch in. Is there anyone I can take him to? (If Scratch is at camp)
    • Gomwick
      ... we have... no one... only... each other...
  • I want to help Scratch. How can I calm him? (If Scratch is at camp)
    • Gomwick
      ... always has... stick... happy... wagging...
